svg.title: One shelf, from the gap to the fix
svg.desc: Example data, a 216-product test shelf. 1: 357 fields missing, 94 cannot be told apart. 2: attributes scored against 32 shopper requirements. 3: screen size first, processor third though 162 miss it. 4: screen size on all 216, 185 told apart, up from 122.

g.text: Ranked by bits of decision information

div.p: 216 test-shelf products: 94 cannot be told apart. 357 fields are missing.
Every attribute is scored against 32 shopper requirements.
Screen size comes first. Processor, the emptiest, is only third.
Screen size recorded on all 216: 185 products can now be told apart, up from 122.
